## Regression — Issue #1758: suiteMove `move` silently turned a malformed `new_parent_id` into an in-container reorder

**Screen:** `gui/templates/testcases/suiteMove.html` · **BFF:** `api/suitemove/index.php`
**Precondition**

- App on `http://localhost:8082`, logged in as `admin`/`admin`.
- MariaDB `127.0.0.1:3306`, db `testlink`, user/pass `testlink`/`testlink`. The DB is empty on a fresh run.
- Fixture: `php tmp/fixtures_1759.php` → project `1`, root node `1`, suites `3` (A-suite-1) and `4` (A-suite-2) both direct children of the root.
- Session for curl: POST `tl_login=admin&tl_password=admin&login=Login` to `/login.php` (cookie `TESTLINK1920TESTLINK_USER_AUTH_COOKIE`). Every write call sends a same-origin CSRF header:
  `-H 'Origin: http://localhost:8082' -H 'Referer: http://localhost:8082/gui/templates/testcases/suiteMove.html'`.
- `API=http://localhost:8082/api/suitemove/index.php`. Before each `move` case, reset the root order to `[3,4]` with
  `POST $API?action=move  tproject_id=1&node_id=3&position=top&new_parent_id=1`.

**Repro (pre-fix), was a real silent write:**

- `POST $API?action=move  node_id=3&position=bottom&new_parent_id=1.5` → observed `200 {"status":"ok","changed":true}` and the root order became `[4,3]` (a silent in-container reorder); `intval('1.5') === 1`, the suite's own current parent.
- `POST $API?action=move  node_id=3&position=bottom` with **JSON** body `{"new_parent_id":"abc"}` → observed `200 ok` + reorder `[3,4]→[4,3]`; the guard read `$_REQUEST`, which does not carry a JSON body.

**Expected (post-fix):** a malformed destination answers `400 bad_request` and the stored order is untouched; a valid destination still moves; `up`/`down` still ignore the destination; `reorder` unchanged.

### A. Malformed destinations — `position=bottom`, node 3 first (`new_parent_id` form-encoded unless noted)

| # | `new_parent_id` | Expected | Observed (post-fix) | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `abc` | `400 bad_request`, order `[3,4]` | `400 {"code":"bad_request","message":"Invalid destination test suite"}`, order unchanged | PASS |
| 2 | `-1` | `400 bad_request` | `400 bad_request` | PASS |
| 3 | `1.5` (`intval`=1=parent) | `400 bad_request` (was `200` + reorder) | `400 bad_request`, order `[3,4]` | PASS |
| 4 | `3.9` (`intval`=3=self) | `400 bad_request` (was `409 cycle`) | `400 bad_request` | PASS |
| 5 | `1e3` (`intval`=1000) | `400 bad_request` (was `404`) | `400 bad_request` | PASS |
| 6 | `75.5` (`intval`=75) | `400 bad_request` (was `404`) | `400 bad_request` | PASS |
| 7 | `%2B5` (literal `+5`) | `400 bad_request` | `400 bad_request` | PASS |
| 8 | `1E3` / `0x4` / `4abc` | `400 bad_request` | `400 bad_request` on each | PASS |
| 9 | JSON `"abc"` (`Content-Type: application/json`) | `400 bad_request`, order `[3,4]` | `400 bad_request`, order unchanged | PASS |
| 10 | JSON `1.5` | `400 bad_request` | `400 bad_request` | PASS |
| 11 | `new_parent_id[]=x` (array) | `400 bad_request`, no `Array to string` E_WARNING | `400 bad_request` | PASS |

### B. Valid / omitted destinations and untouched paths

| # | Step | Expected | Observed | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | `new_parent_id=4` | `200`, suite 3 becomes child of suite 4 | `200`, `container.id=4`, suite 3 `parent_id=4` | PASS |
| 13 | `new_parent_id=0` | `200`, fallback to current parent | `200`, in-container reorder | PASS |
| 14 | `new_parent_id` absent | `200`, fallback to current parent | `200` | PASS |
| 15 | `new_parent_id=' 4 '` (surrounding spaces) | `200` (trimmed to 4) | `200`, moved under 4 | PASS |
| 16 | JSON `new_parent_id: 4` | `200` | `200`, moved under 4 | PASS |
| 17 | `position=down` with `new_parent_id=abc` | destination ignored (documented), `200` | `200`, reorder applied | PASS |
| 18 | `position=up` with `new_parent_id=abc` at boundary | `200 no_change` | `200 {"status":"no_change"}` | PASS |
| 19 | `reorder` `nodelist=75.5,76` / `1e3` / `3,4x` | `400 bad_request` | `400 bad_request` on each | PASS |
| 20 | `reorder` `nodelist=4,3` | `200`, order `[4,3]` | `200`, order `[4,3]` | PASS |
| 21 | `events` table after the whole run | 0 new Error/Warning | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE log_level IN ('ERROR','WARNING')` = `0` | PASS |

**Gate**: `TLU_REQUIRE_SUITE="Issue #1758" bash ai/verify_test_suites.sh` → see run below.

**Result: 21/21 PASS** — every malformed destination (`abc`, `-1`, `1.5`, `3.9`, `1e3`, `75.5`, `%2B5`, JSON `"abc"`, JSON `1.5`, array) now answers `400 bad_request` and leaves the tree untouched; valid, omitted, `0`, whitespace-padded and JSON-integer destinations still move; `up`/`down` and `reorder` are unchanged; 0 Event-Viewer rows. Fix: `api/suitemove/index.php` `move` branch — validate the raw `new_parent_id` (`/^\d+$/`) through `getParam()` before the `≤ 0` fallback (commit on `fix/issue-1758-malformed-destination`).

### C. Addendum — JSON non-integer TYPES rejected too (code-review follow-up)

The first cut only ran the digit regex on the stringified raw value, so a JSON **boolean** slipped
through: `(string)true === "1"` matched `^\d+$`, but `getInt()` reads a boolean as `0`, producing
the same silent in-container reorder. The guard now also rejects any raw value that is neither a
string nor an int, so booleans and floats are refused.

| # | `new_parent_id` | Expected | Observed | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 22 | JSON `true` | `400 bad_request`, order `[3,4]` (was `200` + reorder) | `400 bad_request`, order unchanged | PASS |
| 23 | JSON `1e3` (float) | `400 bad_request` | `400 bad_request` | PASS |
| 24 | JSON `4` (int) | `200`, moves under 4 | `200`, `container.id=4` | PASS |
| 25 | JSON `null` | `200`, treated as destination omitted | `200`, fallback to current parent | PASS |
| 26 | form `1.5` / JSON `"abc"` re-check after the type guard | `400 bad_request` | `400 bad_request` | PASS |

**Result: 26/26 PASS** (`21` above + `5` here).

  parameter the BFFs read — `?action[]=x&name[]=x&parent_id[]=5&exec_id[]=1&id[]=1&type[]=x&locale[]=en&apikey[]=x

## Regression — Issue #1914: PHP 8.2 dynamic-property deprecations in bugzilla/trac/tuleap/jira interfaces

**Precondition:** fresh TestLink DB, app at `http://localhost:8082`, login admin/admin. PHP CLI 8.3.35. `error_reporting(E_ALL)`. The five interfaces below assigned `$this->defaultResolvedStatus` (or `$this->statusDomain` in `jirarestInterface`) without declaring the property, and neither name is declared on the base `issueTrackerInterface`.
**Root cause / fix:** PHP 8.2 deprecates implicit property creation. Declare `var $defaultResolvedStatus;` in `bugzilladb`/`bugzillaxmlrpc`/`tracxmlrpc`/`tuleaprest` (the parent `issueTrackerInterface::setResolvedStatusCfg()` reads it at `issueTrackerInterface.class.php:639`, so it cannot be `private`; `var` mirrors the sibling interfaces) and `private $statusDomain = array();` in `jirarestInterface` (never read by the parent).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PHP syntax | `php -l` on the 5 touched files | no errors | `No syntax errors detected` ×5 | PASS |
| 2 | Pre-fix deprecations | `php tmp/repro_1914.php` (only the 4 conditional/unconditional ctor sites reachable) | ≥5 dynamic-property deprecations | bugzilladb=1, bugzillaxmlrpc=1, tracxmlrpc=1, tuleaprest=1, jirarest statusDomain-write=1; exit 1 | PASS (bug confirmed) |
| 3 | Post-fix deprecations | `php tmp/repro_1914.php` | 0 | all 5 `deprecations=0`; exit 0 | PASS |
| 4 | Property declared on own class | reflection `hasProperty()` + `getDeclaringClass()` | YES ×5 | `declared(own)=YES` ×5 | PASS |
| 5 | Parent still reads the property | live `POST /api/issuetracker/index.php/test-connection` type=2 (bugzilladb) against the local MariaDB | 200 `connected:true`, no fatal | `{"status":"ok","connected":true,...}` HTTP 200, 0 `Cannot access private property` events | PASS |
| 6 | Non-connected interface ctor | live `POST /test-connection` type=27 (tuleap, dead host) | 200 JSON, no dynamic-property fatal | `{"status":"ok","connected":false,...}` HTTP 200 | PASS |
| 7 | BFF auth still works | authenticated `GET /api/issuetracker/index.php/` | JSON, `canManage:true` | `{"status":"ok","canManage":true,"items":[],"total":0}` | PASS |
| 8 | Event Viewer (no new Error/Warning) | `SELECT * FROM events` after the type=2 connect (events cleared first) | no dynamic-property fatal rows | only 1 row: `log_level=1` from `tuleaprestInterface::connect` (outbound connection failure to the dead probe host — pre-existing, unrelated to dynamic properties) | PASS |

**Actual result: fixed** — all five dynamic-property deprecations are gone (CLI harness 5 → 0), the four properties stay public so the parent `setResolvedStatusCfg()` keeps working, and the live `test-connection` route for a connectable bugzilla DB returns `connected:true` with no `Cannot access private property` fatal.

## Regression — Issue #1818: a successful Assign/Unassign left busy=true, so every later button was a silent no-op

**Precondition** — Modernized screen `gui/templates/cfields/cfieldsTprojectAssign.html`
(BFF `/api/cfieldstproject/index.php`). Fixture `php tmp/fixtures_1816.php`:
test project **CFP Main = 1**, cfields 1+2 linked to it, 3/4 available, 5 linked to project 2.
Logged in as admin/admin. Pre-fix state served from a copy so the fixed tree stayed intact:
`git show 3128139a4^:gui/templates/cfields/cfieldsTprojectAssign.html > tmp/issue1818_prefix.html`
(url `/tmp/issue1818_prefix.html?tproject_id=1`); post-fix state = the real route
`/gui/templates/cfields/cfieldsTprojectAssign.html?tproject_id=1`.

**Repro (pre-fix)** — tick an *Available* row → **Assign** (field IS linked), then change
*Display order* and press **Save display attributes**. Measured: `busy=true` permanently;
Refresh/Back stay `disabled`; the Save button is re-enabled by the re-render yet its click is
dropped at `guard()`'s `if (busy) return;`; **0** requests to `?action=save`; the DB keeps
`display_order=1` while the input shows `7` — the edit is silently lost.

**Expected post-fix** — every settled write resets `busy` and re-enables the toolbar; Save
actually POSTs and persists; Refresh/Back/Assign/Unassign all keep working after any Assign/Unassign.

| # | Step | Expected / observed | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-1818-01 | PRE-FIX: Assign CFP1812REQ (id 3) on `issue1818_prefix.html` | `busy=true`, Refresh+Back `disabled`, `linked=[3,1,2]` (assign itself lands) | PASS (repro) |
| TC-1818-02 | PRE-FIX: set order_1=7 → Save | `saveRequests=0` (0→0), input keeps `7`, DB `display_order=1` → change silently lost | PASS (repro) |
| TC-1818-03 | POST-FIX: Assign id 3 → measure `busy`/toolbar | `busy=false`, Refresh/Back/Save all enabled, `linked=[3,1,2]`, toast `1 custom field(s) assigned.` | PASS |
| TC-1818-04 | POST-FIX: order_1=7 → Save display attributes | `action=save` fired ×1 (pre-fix 0), `busy=false`, toast `1 change(s) saved.`, DB `display_order=7` | PASS |
| TC-1818-05 | POST-FIX: press Refresh while idle | `action=init` fired ×1, `busy=false`, table repainted | PASS |
| TC-1818-06 | POST-FIX: Save with no changes | toast `No changes to save.`, `busy=false`, toolbar enabled | PASS |
| TC-1818-07 | POST-FIX: tick linked id 3 → Unassign → confirm modal → Unassign | modal shown, `busy=false`, `linked=[1,2]`, `available=[5,4,3]`, toast `1 custom field(s) unassigned.`, DB row gone | PASS |
| TC-1818-08 | POST-FIX: `events` table Error/Warning count | 0 before and after (no new Error/Warning) | PASS |
| TC-1818-09 | Merge-base gate | `TLU_REQUIRE_SUITE="Issue #1818" bash ai/verify_test_suites.sh` exits 0 | PASS |

### Test execution
- [PASS] TC-1818-01/02 — pre-fix symptom reproduced (measured via `window.busy`,
  `performance.getEntriesByType('resource')` and the DB).
- [PASS] TC-1818-03 .. TC-1818-07 — post-fix write matrix, all five named controls alive.
- [PASS] TC-1818-08 — Event Viewer clean.
- [PASS] Fix already landed as `3128139a4` (`release()` in both `.done()` handlers,
  `gui/templates/cfields/cfieldsTprojectAssign.html:435,464`); this run verified, documented and closed.

### Notes
- Chosen fix = call `release()` in the two missing `.done()` handlers (the issue's own
  suggestion). Rejected: auto-releasing `guard()` via a promise `.always()` (larger guard-contract
  change; every write path already releases explicitly — done → `release()`, fail → `writeError()` → `release()`).
- Same commit also carried the #1819 count-aware toast; that is a separate issue.
- Screenshots: `docs/screenshots/issue-1818-prefix-save-discarded.png` (pre-fix),
  `docs/screenshots/issue-1818-postfix-save-sent.png` (post-fix).

## Regression — Issue #1860: tcEdit.php activate/deactivate-version & create-new-version returned HTTP 500 from a Smarty Compiler error in gui/templates/dashio/include/attachments.inc.tpl

**Precondition:** TestLink 2.0.1 running at http://localhost:8082 (PHP built-in server), DB freshly imported, logged in as admin/admin. Fixture recreates tproject `TC Edit 1859` + suite + test cases (tcase_id=6 with active tcversion_id=7).

**Fixture (recreate data):**
```bash
php tmp/fixtures_1859.php   # prints: tcase_active=6, tcversion_active=7
JAR=/tmp/j1860; rm -f $JAR
curl -s -c $JAR -b $JAR -o /dev/null http://localhost:8082/index.php
curl -s -c $JAR -b $JAR -o /dev/null -d 'tl_login=admin&tl_password=admin' http://localhost:8082/login.php
```

**Root cause (pre-fix):** Smarty 4.5.7 `auto_literal` parses the unescaped `{` in `function(b,t,i){deleteAttachment_onClick(...)}` in the attachment delete link as a template tag → whole-template compile fails at `attachments.inc.tpl:106` with `Unexpected "javascript", expected one of: "" , ")"`.

**TC-1860-1 (deactivate version) — pre-fix result**
1. `curl -s -b $JAR -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}\n' 'http://localhost:8082/lib/testcases/tcEdit.php?deactivate_this_tcversion=1&tcase_id=6&tcversion_id=7'`
- Expected (pre-fix, bug): 500 / 0 bytes (DB row deactivated but no UI feedback).
- **ACTUAL: 500 0** (FAIL, reproduces bug). Server log: `PHP Fatal error: Uncaught --> Smarty Compiler: Syntax error in template ... attachments.inc.tpl on line 106 ... Unexpected "javascript"`.

**TC-1860-2 (activate version) — pre-fix result**
1. `.../tcEdit.php?activate_this_tcversion=1&tcase_id=6&tcversion_id=7` → **ACTUAL: 500 0** (FAIL).

**TC-1860-3 (create new version) — pre-fix result**
1. `.../tcEdit.php?do_create_new_version=1&tcase_id=6&tcversion_id=7` → **ACTUAL: 500 0** (FAIL).

**Post-fix expected:** all three return HTTP 200 with a non-zero body (refreshed testcase / new version edit form) and no Smarty fatal in `tmp/php_server.log`.

**TC-1860-4/5/6 (post-fix, after editing attachments.inc.tpl + inc_attachments.tpl)**
1. Re-run the three curls above.
- **ACTUAL: deactivate → 200 (35239 B); activate → 200 (35109 B); create-new-version → 200 (87791 B)** → **PASS / PASS / PASS**.
2. `tmp/php_server.log` tail shows `[200]: GET /lib/testcases/tcEdit.php?deactivate...`, `[200]: GET ...activate...`, `[200]: GET ...do_create_new_version...`; no new Smarty Compiler fatal → **PASS**.

**TC-1860-7 (template compile isolation, Smarty 4.5.7)**
1. Compile pre-fix copies (`git show HEAD:gui/templates/dashio/include/attachments.inc.tpl` and `.../inc_attachments.tpl`) through Smarty 4.5.7 → **ACTUAL: syntax error at line 106 / line 75** (FAIL, bug present).
2. Compile post-fix working-tree copies → parse succeeds (remaining error is only the isolated-harness "Unable to load config/include" artifact from the minimal template dir, i.e. the full-template PARSE now passes the fix line) → **PASS**.

**TC-1860-8 (blast-radius / no drive-by):** `git diff --stat` shows only the 2 dashio attachment templates modified; `grep -n "function(b,t,i){ deleteAttachment_onClick" gui/templates/dashio/include/*.tpl` → both fixed; tl-classic left untouched because `lib/functions/tlsmarty.inc.php:101-103` hardcodes `template_dir` to `gui/templates/dashio/` (tl-classic is dead code) → **PASS**.

**Result: 6 PASS / 0 FAIL (TC-1860-1..3 are the documented pre-fix FAIL that the fix resolves; post-fix cases TC-1860-4..8 all PASS).**

## Regression — Issue #1916: tcEdit.php post-action render emitted 18 E_WARNING rows (tcViewViewer.inc.tpl / tcbody.inc.tpl unset vars)

**Screen / area:** Test Design → test case viewer, legacy `lib/testcases/tcEdit.php` post-action render path (activate / deactivate / create-new-version / do_copy) → `testcase::show()` → `tcView.tpl` → `tcViewViewer.inc.tpl` → `tcbody.inc.tpl`.

**Precondition:** Fresh DB. Fixture `php tmp/fixtures_1859.php` → creates tproject `TC Edit 1859`, one active test case + one version (ids vary per run; record `tcase_active` / `tcversion_active` from stdout). Logged in as `admin`/`admin` at `http://localhost:8082`. Baseline (pre-fix) measured on this fixture: the three URLs below wrote **18 `E_WARNING` rows** (`log_level=2`) into `events`.

**Pre-fix repro steps (expected FAIL before the fix):**
1. `php tmp/fixtures_1859.php` → note `tcase_active=T` and `tcversion_active=V`.
2. `DELETE FROM events;`
3. `GET /lib/testcases/tcEdit.php?deactivate_this_tcversion=1&tcase_id=T&tcversion_id=V` → 200, **1** `E_WARNING` (`Undefined property: stdClass::$delete_frozen_tcversion`, `tcViewViewer.inc.tpl` src :286).
4. `GET /lib/testcases/tcEdit.php?do_create_new_version=1&tcase_id=T&tcversion_id=V` → 200, **16** `E_WARNING` (2× `delete_frozen_tcversion` src :238, 2× `Undefined array key "ghost_preconditions"` `tcbody.inc.tpl` src :73, 12× `Trying to access array offset on null` `tcbody.inc.tpl`).
5. `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE log_level=2;` → 18.

**Expected post-fix behavior:** each of the three post-action URLs still returns HTTP 200 and renders the test-case viewer, but writes **zero** `E_WARNING` rows; `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE log_level IN (1,2,4,8)` → `0` (only `log_level=16` audit rows from ACTIVATE/DEACTIVATE remain). The viewer still shows the test-case name, steps and the `new_version` / `delete_tc_version` buttons unchanged.

**Fix applied (minimal, behaviour-preserving):**
- RC1 — add `delete_frozen_tcversion` to both grant lists: `lib/testcases/testcaseCommands.class.php` (`g2c`) and `lib/testcases/tcEdit.php` (`grant2check`), so `testcase::initShowGui()` (`testcase.class.php:7504-7506`) copies it onto `can_do`.
- RC2 — set `ghost_preconditions` on other-version rows: `lib/functions/testcase.class.php:1210-1214` (mirrors current-version line 1087).
- RC3 — `switch ($cfpKey)` → `switch ($locKey)` in the other-versions CF loop: `lib/functions/testcase.class.php:~1222`, so `$gui->cf_other_versions` is actually built (was left `null` by the stale `$cfpKey`).

**Actual result observed (post-fix):** PASS — 4 post-action renders (`deactivate`, `activate`, `create_new_version` ×2 → two other-version viewer rows) all returned 200; `COUNT(events WHERE log_level=2)=0`; `COUNT(log_level IN (1,2,4,8))=0`; histogram `{16: 2}` (audit only). Rendered HTML `bytes=112991`, test-case name ×16, `new_version` ×3, `delete_tc_version` ×2 present. Headless-Chrome console: only 1 pre-existing `Deprecated feature used` notice, no JS errors. Screenshot: `docs/screenshots/issue-1916-tcEdit-postaction-render.png`.

## Regression — Issue #1831: `TLi18n.t(...) || 'English'` unreachable-fallback antipattern (hardcoded strings, rule 3)

**Screen / area:** i18n consumption across the modern screens (the #1829 idiom, swept via the issue's `grep -rn "TLi18n\.t([^)]*) *||" gui/templates/`). Refs #1831, #1829.

**Precondition:** app at `http://localhost:8082`; login `admin`/`admin`. `TLi18n.t()` returns `_strings[key] || key` (`i18n.js:175`), never `undefined`/`''`, so `t(k) || 'literal'` can never use the literal.

| # | Step | Input | Expected | Observed | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Sweep for the idiom | `grep -rn "TLi18n\.t([^)]*) *||" gui/templates/` | no hardcoded-English-literal fallback remains | only inside-args false positives (`\|\| '-'`,`\|\| 0`,`\|\| login`) and dynamic-key fallbacks (`\|\| key`) remain | PASS |
| 2 | `etl.noData` key present | grep all 10 bundles | 10/10 | 10/10 | PASS |
| 3 | `common.loading` key present | grep all 10 bundles | 10/10 | 10/10 | PASS |
| 4 | `tcPerUser.filterAll` key present | grep all 10 bundles | 10/10 | 10/10 | PASS |
| 5 | JS syntax of the 3 touched files | extract inline `<script>`, `node --check` | no errors | OK | PASS |
| 6 | execTimelineStats empty message | `$('#timelineTable').DataTable().settings()[0].oLanguage.sEmptyTable` | the translated string, not the raw key | `"No execution data available for this test plan."` (= `TLi18n.t('etl.noData')`), not `etl.noData` | PASS |
| 7 | execTimelineStats regression | open `?tproject_id=15&tplan_id=16` | table renders | table rendered, 1 row, tplan "RB Plan", console clean | PASS |
| 8 | `filterAll` resolves | `TLi18n.t('tcPerUser.filterAll')`, `TLi18n.has(...)` | `All`, true | `All`, true; no raw-key leak in rendered options | PASS |
| 9 | Noteworthy: the deleted literal was wrong | compare literal vs bundle | they differ | bundle = "…for this test plan.", literal = "No execution data available" | PASS |
| 10 | Event Viewer | `SELECT … WHERE log_level IN (2,3)` | no new Error/Warning | none | PASS |

**Actual result: 10/10 PASS.** Root cause: `t(key) || 'English'` copied on the belief that `t()` returns `undefined`/empty for a missing key; it never does (`i18n.js:175`), so the literal is dead and merely keeps a hardcoded English string (forbidden by rule 3). Fixed by treating the keys as mandatory and deleting the dead literals (the i18n coverage gate enforces presence). Refs #1831, #1829.

**Gate:** `TLU_REQUIRE_SUITE="Issue #1831" bash ai/verify_test_suites.sh`.

## Regression — Issue #1853: `_build_cfield()` kept an ARRAY `cf_value` for a date-shaped key on a non-date field → `design_values_to_db()`/`tlStringLen()` PHP 8 TypeError (HTTP 500)

**Screen / area:** shared custom-field write path `cfield_mgr::_build_cfield()` (`lib/functions/cfield_mgr.class.php`), used by every CF write (test suites, cases, requirements, plans, builds, executions). Refs #1853, #1852.

**Precondition:** app at `http://localhost:8082`; `php tmp/t1853.php` calls `_build_cfield()` directly with constructed hashes/defs (no DB write).

| # | Step | Input | Expected | Observed | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PHP lint | `php -l lib/functions/cfield_mgr.class.php` | no syntax errors | `No syntax errors detected` | PASS |
| 2 | BEFORE: string field + date-shaped key | `_build_cfield({'custom_field_0_12_input':''}, {12:{type:0}})` | array survives (the bug) | `array('input' => '')` | PASS |
| 3 | AFTER: string field + date-shaped key | same | scalar `''`, not an array | `''` | PASS |
| 4 | AFTER: mismatch + array value | `{'custom_field_0_12_input':array('x','y')}` | flattened to `''` | `''` | PASS |
| 5 | BEFORE: mismatch + array value | same | nested array survives | `array('input' => array('x','y'))` | PASS |
| 6 | Real date field still works | `{'custom_field_8_12_input':'2026-01-02','…_hour':'3',…_minute':'4',…_second':'5'}` | flattened to a timestamp (mktime) | `1184803200` | PASS |
| 7 | Plain non-suffixed string key | `{'custom_field_0_12':'hello'}` | scalar preserved | `'hello'` | PASS |
| 8 | Multiselection (type 7, array, no suffix) not broken | `{'custom_field_7_12':array('a','b')}` | `'a|b'` | `'a|b'` | PASS |
| 9 | Downstream fatal reproduced | `tlStringLen(array('input'=>''))` | PHP 8 `TypeError` (the issue's symptom) | `TypeError: iconv_strlen(): Argument #1 ($string) must be of type string, array given` | PASS |
| 10 | Event Viewer | `SELECT … WHERE log_level IN (2,3)` after the harness | no new Error/Warning | none | PASS |

**Actual result: 10/10 PASS.** Root cause: `_build_cfield()` classified a hash key as a date part by suffix alone (`cfield_mgr.class.php:1938`), never checking the field's type; the per-type switch has no branch to flatten an array for a scalar type, so the array reached `design_values_to_db()` (`:859`) where `max_length_value > 0` calls `tlStringLen()` -> `iconv_strlen()` (PHP 8 `TypeError`, HTTP 500). Fix: only merge per-part keys when the key's `type_id` maps to `date`/`datetime`, else fall through to the scalar branch (array value flattened to `''`). Refs #1853, #1852.

**Gate:** `TLU_REQUIRE_SUITE="Issue #1853" bash ai/verify_test_suites.sh`.

## Task — Issue #1081: generated-on timestamp footer in searchReqSpec

**Precondition**

```bash
mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -utestlink -ptestlink testlink < tmp/fixtures_1081.sql
# -> test project 9081 "Footer Fixture Project", 2 req specs
#    (SPEC alpha 2 revisions, SPEC beta 1), admin (id 1) role 8
# plus the too-wide project 9091 "Wide Fixture Project" with 205 req specs
# (config.inc.php:1684 req_cfg->search->max_qty_for_display = 200).
# Log in admin/admin.
```

**Steps / expected / actual**

| # | Step | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `GET /api/requirements/index.php/reqspec-search?tproject_id=9081` | payload carries the stamp: `generated_on` (session-locale format) + `generated_on_iso` | PASS — keys `status,count,rows,warning,generated_on,generated_on_iso`; `generated_on` = `04/10/2026 19:53:45` = `locales_timestamp_format['en_GB']` (`%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S`), ISO = `2026-10-04 19:53:45` |
| 2 | open `searchReqSpec.html?tproject_id=9081`, press **Find** | results table + footer block with the italic 3-line hint and "Generated by TestLink on <date>" | PASS — `#footerGenerated` `display:block`, hint 3 `<br>`-separated lines, `Generated by TestLink on 04/10/2026 19:53:45`, `title` = ISO, `#footerInfo` still `Matches: 2`, 2 rows |
| 3 | search `Title = ZZZ-no-such-spec` | legacy warning box, **no** generated-on line (legacy `{if !warning}`) | PASS — warn "No requirement specifications match the given criteria.", `#footerGenerated` `display:none` |
| 4 | same URL `?tproject_id=9091`, press **Find** (205 specs > cap 200) | `too_wide_search_criteria` warning, no table, **no** generated-on line | PASS — `(Matches: 205)`, warn "Too many results, please refine the search criteria.", table hidden, footer `display:none` |
| 5 | press **Reset** | stamp and hint cleared, criteria cleared | PASS — `#footerGenerated` `display:none`, hint `""`, stamp `""`, `title` `null`, Title field `""` |
| 6 | same screen with `&locale=de` | German hint + `common.generatedBy` = "Generiert von TestLink am", German format | PASS — hint in German (3 lines), stamp "Generiert von TestLink am 04/10/2026 20:06:10", `(Treffer: 2)` |
| 7 | repeat a search in the same session | stamp refreshed to the new render time | PASS — 19:53:45 → 20:07:19 across searches, `title` follows |
| 8 | console + Event Viewer after the whole pass | zero new Error/Warning entries | PASS — 0 console errors/warnings; `events` holds only the level-16 login audit row, no new Error/Warning |

**Notes**

- The stamp format follows the **session** language (`locales_timestamp_format[$session
  locale]`, exactly like legacy `tlsmarty.inc.php:304`), while the label/hint follow the
  client-side `?locale=` bundle override — the same split legacy had between the server
  rendered timestamp and the language strings.
- The hint is stored as `\n`-separated paragraphs (no HTML inside the JSON) and rendered
  escaped, so a translation can never inject markup.

**RESUME**

```bash
mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -utestlink -ptestlink testlink < tmp/fixtures_1081.sql
```

## Task — Issue #1279: Test review / static-testing workflow (ISTQB #1054)

### Precondition
- TestLink 2.0.1 at http://localhost:8082, admin/admin logged in.
- Test project "Review Demo" (id=1, prefix RDEMO) with requirements enabled
  (`POST /api/projects/1/requirements {"enabled":1}` -> optReq=1).
- Fixtures: test suite node id=2 ("Demo Suite"), test case id=3/version node 4
  ("Login validation"), requirement spec id=6 ("Demo Spec"), requirement id=8 /
  version node 9 ("REQ-1 Password policy requirement").
- BFF `api/reviews/index.php` present; `tc_reviews` in `getDBTables()` whitelist
  (`lib/functions/object.class.php`); menu entry in `api/aside/index.php` section 7b.

### Steps to exercise the new feature
1. GET `?action=meta&tproject_id=1` -> statuses/entity_types/candidates + canRequest*.
2. GET `?action=list&tproject_id=1` -> items + status counts + tproject_name.
3. GET `?action=entities&tproject_id=1&entity_type=tcase` and `...=requirement`.
4. POST `?action=create` for a tcase and a requirement review.
5. POST `?action=decide` with `approved` on the requirement review.
6. POST `?action=decide` with `rejected` on the tcase review.
7. Browser: open `/gui/templates/reviews/reviews.html?tproject_id=1`; verify tiles,
   DataTable rows, filters and i18n (EN + RO); create a review from the modal;
   record a decision from the modal.
8. Verify entity status sync: `req_versions.status` -> F on approve; `tcversions.status`
   -> 4 on reject; -> 7 on approve.
9. Verify ASIDE menu entry "Review" (section 7b) resolves to reviews.html.
10. Event Viewer / `events` table: no new Error/Warning rows from the screen.

### Expected behavior
- Review requests are created/updated in `tc_reviews`; list returns joined logins and
  per-status counts; decisions sync the underlying entity status; all UI strings come
  from TLi18n in every locale; menu entry appears for users with view rights.

### Actual result observed
- Step 1: `{"status":"ok","statuses":[in_review,approved,rejected,cancelled],
  "entity_types":[tcase,requirement],"candidates":[admin],"canRequestTc":true,"canRequestReq":true}`.
- Step 2: `tproject_name":"Review Demo"`, items + counts correct.
- Step 3 tcase: `[{entity_id:3,version_id:4,title:"Login validation",...}]`;
  requirement: `[{entity_id:8,version_id:9,title:"Password policy requirement",doc_id:"REQ-1",version:1}]`.
- Step 4: `{"status":"ok","id":1/2,"message":"Review requested"}`.
- Step 5: requirement review -> approved; DB `req_versions.status` id 9 = **F**.
- Step 6: tcase review -> rejected; DB `tcversions.status` id 4 = **4** (rework).
- Step 7: screen renders tiles IN REVIEW/APPROVED/REJECTED, both rows + doc ids,
  filters (Type/Status/Reviewer), RO labels translate; modal create -> toasts
  "Review request created."; modal approve -> "Review decision recorded." and counts
  move to APPROVED 2 / REJECTED 1. Screenshot `docs/screenshots/issue-1279-reviews.png`.
- Step 8: verified via SQL above; also approve path for tcase verified via API earlier
  (status 4 -> 7).
- Step 9: `api/aside/index.php?action=init` returns `Review` href
  `/gui/templates/reviews/reviews.html?tproject_id=1&tplan_id=0`.
- Step 10: no error/warning from reviews API in `events`.

### Result: PASS (9/9 curls + browser create/decide; 1 defect found and fixed)
Defect fixed during the run: requirement entity listing originally joined
`req_versions.id = requirements.id`; in 2.0.1 the version node is a CHILD of the
requirement node, so requirements returned empty. Fixed to
`nodes_hierarchy(parent_id = requirements.id) JOIN req_versions ON req_versions.id = child.id`,
returning the latest version (verified id 8 -> version node 9).

### Security re-check (object-level authorization, added during code review)
- PASS: `POST ?action=create` with spoofed `entity_title="SPOOFED"`, `entity_doc_id="HACK"`,
  `version_id=99999` and a valid `entity_id=3` stores the DB-derived tuple (title
  "Login validation", doc id "1", version node 4) — spoofed values ignored.
- PASS: unknown entity id 99999 -> HTTP 404 "Entity not found in this test project".
- PASS: unknown reviewer id 99999 -> HTTP 400 "Reviewer is not a member of this test project".

## Regression — Issue #1811: checkForBTSConnection() is dead code — legacy security notes never warn about a failing Bug Tracking System

**Precondition**

- Freshly imported TestLink at `http://localhost:8082` (PHP built-in server, docroot = repo
  root), MariaDB `127.0.0.1:3306` db/user/password `testlink`. Login `admin/admin`.
- Fixture `php tmp/fixtures_1811.php` (idempotent, `--reset` drops it) creates:
  - test project `BTS1811` with `issue_tracker_enabled = 1`,
  - test plan `BTS1811-plan` (so `initUserEnv()` consumers are reachable),
  - issue tracker `BTS1811-down`, **type 15** (redmine + rest →
    `redminerestInterface`, `tlIssueTracker.class.php:63-64`), `cfg` with
    `<uribase>http://127.0.0.1:1</uribase>` — a CLOSED local port, so `connect()`
    fails in ~2-3 ms with `ECONNREFUSED` instead of burning `default_socket_timeout`,
  - linked to the project via `tlIssueTracker::link()`.
- Optional (git-ignored) `custom_config.inc.php` fixture to force a warning mode /
  frequency; the shipped defaults are `config_check_warning_mode = 'FILE'`
  (`config.inc.php:361`) and `config_check_warning_frequence = 'ONCE_FOR_SESSION'`
  (`config.inc.php:367`).
- Harness `php tmp/verify_1811.php` runs cases A-D below and fails on any
  `E_WARNING`/`E_NOTICE`/`E_USER_*` raised inside the check (`E_DEPRECATED` excluded:
  pre-existing PHP 8.2 dynamic-property notices, filed as #1815).

**Steps to reproduce (pre-fix)**

1. `php tmp/fixtures_1811.php` — prints the linked tracker, then the four measurements.
2. Compare `checkForBTSConnection($db)` with `checkForBTSConnection()` and inspect
   `getSecurityNotes($db)` / `logs/config_check.txt`.

**Pre-fix result (measured on `96bfc55c4`)**

```
checkForBTSConnection($db) = false  (2 ms)      <- DB fallback works …
checkForBTSConnection()     = true   (0 ms)      <- … but this is what getSecurityNotes() passes
getSecurityNotes($db) = array (6 notes, none of them the BTS one)
RESULT: bts_connection_problems note present = false
grep -ci "Bug Tracking System has failed" logs/config_check.txt -> 0
```

**Expected post-fix**

`getSecurityNotes($db)` must contain `$TLS_bts_connection_problems`
(`locale/en_US/strings.txt:2582`) whenever a tracker linked to a project cannot be
connected, and `checkForBTSConnection($db)` must answer `false` for it — while staying
`true` (no false warning) when no tracker is linked at all.

**Actual result observed (post-fix, commit `c5206fd1e`)**

| case | steps | expected | observed | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|

  ("fix(reqtreereorder): disable the whole toolbar on the 403/404 error page (Refs #1681)"),
  an ancestor of the default branch (`git merge-base --is-ancestor 571760ea4 HEAD` -> YES).
  Shape: page-level `DEAD` flag (`:165`) kept deliberately **outside** `GRANT` so a 403 can never
  look like "read-only"; `showState()` sets `DEAD` **and calls `idleUI()`** (`:222`,`:227`) —
  that missing call was the root cause; `hideState()` clears it (`:231`); `idleUI()` folds `DEAD`

## Regression — Issue #1688 (addendum): residual DEAD-state hole in the row controls, found by code review

### Precondition
Same as `## Regression — Issue #1688` above: fixtures tproject 13 / spec 16 (`RS1`) with
requirements 20 (`REQ1`) and 21 (`REQ2`), `admin`/`admin` (role_id 8, has `mgt_modify_req`).

### Why this addendum exists
The first suite proved the **toolbar** goes dead on the error page. The mandatory pre-commit code
review of branch `fix/issue-1688` then measured a **residual hole in the same defect class**: the
`DEAD` flag was honoured by `idleUI()` and by the three toolbar handlers, but the **row** controls
were never folded into it. `applyRowState()` had no `DEAD` term and `showState()` never called it,
`nudge()` guarded only `BUSY || !GRANT.modify`, the `.pickbtn` handler had no guard at all, and the
drop handler guarded `!GRANT.modify || BUSY` without `DEAD`.

It is reachable whenever a page transitions **success -> dead** (init succeeds once, a *later*
`load()` fails — e.g. picking a specification that then 404s). The rows survive the transition, so
on a page the user is not allowed to see, `nudge()` still reordered `ITEMS` and lit the
"Unsaved changes" chip, and `.pickbtn` still armed a Move that could then never be submitted. The
toolbar was dead, the state underneath it was not. Visually hidden (the rows live in `#ordCard`,
which `showState()` hides), which is exactly why the first suite did not catch it.

### Repro steps (pre-fix, measured)
1. Log in as `admin`, open `reqTreeReorder.html?tproject_id=13&req_spec_id=16` -> success,
   `ITEMS = ["REQ1","REQ2"]`, rows draggable, `#dirtyChip` hidden
2. Drive the page into the dead state: `showState('forced','FORCED')` (this is precisely the
   `DEAD = true` + `idleUI()` transition that every error path performs)
3. Force the handlers, bypassing the `disabled` attribute:
   `nudge(0,'down')` and `document.querySelector('#ordBody tr .pickbtn').click()`
4. Observe pre-fix: `ITEMS` becomes `["REQ2","REQ1"]`, `#dirtyChip` turns visible, `PICKED` becomes
   `20` — while the toolbar is correctly disabled

### Expected post-fix behavior
- Every row control folds `DEAD` into its disabled state: `.rm`, `[data-mv]`, `.pickbtn`
- `draggable` is cleared and the grip icon is hidden on a dead page
- `nudge()`, the `.pickbtn` handler and the `drop` handler are no-ops when `DEAD`
- `showState()` calls `applyRowState()`, so a success -> dead transition re-arms the rows
- **Success path untouched**: `nudge()` still reorders, rows stay `draggable="true"`, grip visible,
  `.pickbtn` enabled, only the boundary buttons (top row Up/To top, bottom row Down/To bottom)
  disabled as before

### Actual result observed (verified on `fix/issue-1688`)
| Case | Probe | Measured | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| TC-1688-12 | Success path (pre-transition) as `admin` | `DEAD:false`, `draggable:["true","true"]`, `grip` display `["inline","inline"]`, `.pickbtn` `disabled:false`, `#dirtyChip` `none`, toolbar all `false` | PASS (baseline) |
| TC-1688-13 | Success path — `nudge(0,'down')` still reorders | `ITEMS ["REQ1","REQ2"] -> ["REQ2","REQ1"]` | PASS (no regression) |
| TC-1688-14 | After `showState(...)`: row `draggable` | `"false"` on every row | PASS |
| TC-1688-15 | After `showState(...)`: grip icon `display` | `"none"` on every row | PASS |
| TC-1688-16 | After `showState(...)`: `.pickbtn` | `disabled:true` **and** class `dis` on every row | PASS |
| TC-1688-17 | After `showState(...)`: `[data-mv]` / `.rm` | every button `disabled:true` | PASS |
| TC-1688-18 | After `showState(...)`: `nudge(0,'down')` + `nudge(0,'top')` + `.pickbtn.click()` + `applyOrder()` + `doMove()` + `discard()` (all with `disabled` bypassed) | `ITEMS` unchanged, `PICKED:0`, `#msg` empty, `#confirmModal` `display:none` | PASS |
| TC-1688-19 | 403 path **after** the change, as `tr1681norights` (`?tproject_id=13&req_spec_id=16`) | `DEAD:true`, code `no_right`, all 6 toolbar controls `disabled:true`, `#refreshBtn:false`, `roBanner` hidden, `dragHint` hidden, cards `none`/`none`/`none` + `state:block`, handlers + real click produce no message and no modal | PASS |
| TC-1688-20 | 405 path (`showState('x','HTTP_405')`) | `DEAD:true`, `#applyBtn` `disabled:true` | PASS |
| TC-1688-21 | Event Viewer / `events` after the whole pass | `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE log_level IN (0,1,2)` -> **0** | PASS |

### Test execution
- [PASS] TC-1688-12 .. TC-1688-21 — 10/10 PASS (chrome-devtools MCP, live app)
- [PASS] `node --check` on the extracted `<script>` body of `reqTreeReorder.html` after the edit
- [PASS] Merge-base gate: `TLU_REQUIRE_SUITE="Issue #1688" bash ai/verify_test_suites.sh`

### Notes
- Code change in `gui/templates/requirements/reqTreeReorder.html` (+13 −5), all in the same class:
  - `applyRowState()` — `DEAD` added to the `.rm` condition and to the `[data-mv]` `dis`
    computation; new `DEAD` term for `.pickbtn` (the only row control enabled for a view-only
    user); `draggable` forced to `"false"` and the grip hidden when `DEAD`
  - `showState()` — now calls `applyRowState()` at the end, so the rows follow the toolbar
  - `nudge()` — guard extended to `BUSY || DEAD || !GRANT.modify`
  - the `.pickbtn` click handler — `if (DEAD) { return; }`
  - the `drop` handler — guard extended to `DEAD || !GRANT.modify || BUSY`
- **Session caveat for anyone re-running this**: a code-review subagent logged in as `admin` in
  the *default* browser context, which replaced the `tr1681norights` session cookie there. The
  403/404 cases must be run in their own isolated browser context (or after re-authenticating),
  otherwise the page silently succeeds as `admin` and the case looks like a false PASS. This bit
  this run once; `TC-1688-19` was re-measured in a dedicated `norights` context.

## Regression — Issue #1690: reqTreeReorder back link must carry the user's OWN test project

**Preconditions**

* App up on `http://localhost:8082` (PHP built-in server, docroot = repo root), login `admin` / `admin`.
* Fixtures loaded — `mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -utestlink -ptestlink testlink < tmp/fixtures_1690.sql`.
  A fresh run DB has **0** test projects, and one project is not enough: the defect is only visible when
  the project the screen is opened on is NOT the id that was hardcoded. The fixture therefore creates:

  | id | kind | belongs to |
  |---|---|---|
  | 13 | test project `TL` | — the project the screen was developed against (the hardcoded id) |
  | 60 | test project `ALT` | — a second project; the issue's own repro ids |
  | 21 | req spec `SRS-A` | project 13 |
  | 61 | req spec `SRS-B` | project 60 |

  plus requirements `9011/9012` in spec 21 and `9061/9062/9063` in spec 61 (each with a `req_versions`
  row behind a `node_type_id = 8` node), and requirement-spec revisions for both specs.
* Branch under test: `fix/issue-1690`, commit `d66f0feb7`.

**Symptom (pre-fix, reproduced)**

`gui/templates/requirements/reqTreeReorder.html` is a **static** file served to every project, so an id
baked into its markup is only right for the project it was developed on. Open the screen with
`tproject_id=60` and *Back to specification management* pointed at **`tproject_id=13`** — clicking it
landed on `"Project 13 - Requirement Specification Management"`, a completely unrelated project.

**Expected (post-fix)**

`#backLink` always carries the test project the user is actually working in — on the success path, on the
403/404 path, and on the missing-context path — and never an id belonging to another project.

**Cases**

| # | Case | Input | Expected `#backLink` href | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | success path, in-project | `?tproject_id=60&req_spec_id=61` | `…/reqSpecMgmt.html?tproject_id=60`, target `200`, header *Project 60*, 3 rows, chip `SRS-B` | PASS |
| 2 | 404 path (spec of another project) | `?tproject_id=60&req_spec_id=21`, **referrer says 13** | `…?tproject_id=60` — URL wins, `apiStatus 404`, `stateCode req_spec_not_found`, Apply disabled | PASS |
| 3 | URL must win over the referrer (old hardcoded id) | `?tproject_id=13&req_spec_id=21`, **referrer says 60** | `…?tproject_id=13` (2 rows, chip `SRS-A`) | PASS |
| 4 | **the fix** — no project in the URL | `reqTreeReorder.html` clicked from `reqSpecMgmt.html?tproject_id=60` | `…?tproject_id=60` (state `MISSING_TPROJECT`) — pre-fix this was the id-less dead end | PASS |
| 5 | referrer without a project | clicked from `reqSpecMgmt.html` (no params) | id-less `…/reqSpecMgmt.html` (last resort unchanged) | PASS |
| 6 | cross-origin referrer must never be trusted | clicked from `http://127.0.0.1:8082/…?tproject_id=60` (different origin, same app) | id-less; guard unit-check in-page: `https://evil.example.com/x?tproject_id=99 → 0`, `127.0.0.1 → 0`, same-origin → `60` | PASS |
| 7 | non-numeric project param | `?tproject_id=abc` (`TPROJECT_ID === NaN`) + referrer project 60 | `…?tproject_id=60` — `NaN` does not win, referrer takes over | PASS |
| 8 | the screen still works, the link is inert | project 60 / spec 61: click ↓ on row 1 → *Apply order* → *OK* | *"The new order was saved."*; `nodes_hierarchy.node_order` 1,2,3 → 0,1,2 (id 9062 first); back link still `?tproject_id=60` | PASS |
| 9 | Event Viewer / console | after all of the above | `events` holds only the `log_level 16` `audit_login_succeeded` row — **no Error/Warning**; browser console empty | PASS |

**Gates for this suite**

- `node --check` on the screen's extracted inline `<script>` → PASS
- `git diff` empty after restoring the file the pre-fix measurement temporarily swapped in → PASS
- `TLU_REQUIRE_SUITE="Issue #1690" bash ai/verify_test_suites.sh` → PASS (see the comment on the issue)
- no i18n key added, no backend/DB change — the fix is one function plus its last-resort helper

## Regression — Issue #1829: `reqTreeReorder.html` edge-row Up/Down tooltips leaked the raw i18n KEY

**Precondition**

- App on `http://localhost:8082` (docroot = repo root), TestLink 2.0.1.
- Credentials: `admin` / `admin` (needs `GRANT.modify`), plus the view-only user
  `tr1681readonly` / `admin` created by `php tmp/fixtures_1681.php`
  (`tproject=1`, `req_spec_id=2`, 3 requirements `TR1-1..TR1-3`).
- Screen: `gui/templates/requirements/reqTreeReorder.html`.
- Browser: headless Chrome. A row-order change needs 3 requirements, otherwise the
  screen shows `reqtr.nothing` and no reorder buttons exist at all.

**Repro steps (pre-fix, all verified FAIL)**

1. Login `admin`/`admin`.
2. Open `http://localhost:8082/gui/templates/requirements/reqTreeReorder.html?tproject_id=1&req_spec_id=2`.
3. Read the `title` attribute of the disabled **Up** / **To top** buttons of row 1
   (and **Down** / **To bottom** of the last row).
4. Repeat on `…&locale=ro_RO` / `&locale=de_DE`.
5. Cross-check the bundles: `grep -c 'reqtr\.' gui/templates/i18n/*.json` and
   `python3 -m json.tool <bundle>`.

**Expected (post-fix)**

- Step 3/4 return a **translated sentence**, never `reqtr.alreadyFirst` /
  `reqtr.alreadyLast`.
- Both keys are present in all **10** bundles and every bundle is valid JSON.
- Non-edge rows keep **no** `title` attribute.
- With a key missing from the active bundle the tooltip is **omitted** — no key
  may ever reach the DOM.

**Actual result — PRE-fix (measured, FAIL)**

```
en  : title="reqtr.alreadyFirst" / "reqtr.alreadyLast"   <-- raw KEY, not English
ro  : title="reqtr.alreadyFirst"  while reqtr.moveUp = "Òn sus"   <-- key leaks in every locale
TLi18n.has('reqtr.alreadyFirst') === false
grep -c 'reqtr\.'  -> 53 in all 10 bundles (the two keys absent everywhere)
```

Root cause: `gui/templates/i18n/i18n.js:175` `var str = _strings[key] || key;` —
`t()` returns the **key** for a missing entry, so `t('reqtr.alreadyFirst') ||
'Already the first requirement'` always took the truthy left side and the English
literal was unreachable dead code.

**Actual result — POST-fix (measured, PASS)**

| # | Case | Expected | Measured | Verdict |
|---|------|----------|----------|---------|
| 1 | **en**, row 1 Up + To top | translated tooltip | `Already the first requirement` | PASS |
| 2 | **en**, last row Down + To bottom | translated tooltip | `Already the last requirement` | PASS |
| 3 | **ro_RO**, same 4 buttons | Romanian | `Deja este prima cerință` / `Deja este ultima cerință` | PASS |
| 4 | **de_DE**, same 4 buttons | German | `Bereits die erste/letzte Anforderung` | PASS |
| 5 | middle row (all 4 buttons) | no `title` | `title: null` × 4 | PASS |
| 6 | view-only `tr1681readonly` | all disabled, no key leak | all `aria-disabled="true"`, `rawKeyLeak: []` | PASS |
| 7 | `TLi18n.has()` forced `false` + `render()` | tooltip omitted | `tips: []`, `leak: []`; restoring `has()` brings the 4 tooltips back | PASS |
| 8 | `t()` forced to echo the key (blank bundle value) | tooltip omitted | `tips: []`, `leak: []` | PASS |
| 9 | reorder still functional (admin) | order changes, dirty chip appears | `[6,8,10]` →Down→ `[8,6,10]` (chip `true`) →To top→ `[10,8,6]`; `#discardBtn` restores `[6,8,10]` | PASS |
| 10 | JSON validity of all 10 bundles | valid | `python3 -m json.tool` → OK × 10 | PASS |
| 11 | Event Viewer / `events` table | no new Error/Warning | 4 rows, all `log_level = 16` (audit: project created + 3 logins); 0 Error/Warning, 0 LOCALIZATION | PASS |
| 12 | `node --check` on the screen's inline script | OK | OK | PASS |

**Known limitation (fixed elsewhere / filed separately, NOT part of this fix)**

`.rm.dis, .rm:disabled { pointer-events: none; }` (reqTreeReorder.html:54, added by
`4f074a2b5` for #1804) keeps the disabled edge buttons out of the hover chain, so
the native tooltip is reachable via the **accessibility tree / DOM `title`** but not
by hovering with a mouse. Assert on the attribute / a11y tree, not on hover.

**RESUME**

```bash
php tmp/fixtures_1681.php
# http://localhost:8082/gui/templates/requirements/reqTreeReorder.html?tproject_id=1&req_spec_id=2
# then read document.querySelectorAll('button.rm[title]')
```

## Regression — Issue #1835: `searchReqSpec.html` toolbar rendered the raw key `rssf.criteria` in all 10 locales

**Precondition**

```bash
# fresh DB every run -> (re)import the fixture that creates tproject 9081
mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -utestlink -ptestlink testlink < tmp/fixtures_1081.sql
# app: http://localhost:8082/index.php   login admin/admin
```

**Repro steps (pre-fix behaviour)**

1. Log in `admin`/`admin` at `http://localhost:8082/index.php`.
2. Open `http://localhost:8082/gui/templates/requirements/searchReqSpec.html?tproject_id=9081`.
3. Read the left button of the dark toolbar.

**Result pre-fix** — the raw key was painted as the visible label:

```
uid=1_9 button " rssf.criteria"      <-- expected "Criteria form"
uid=1_10 button "  Reset"             <-- sibling button WAS translated
```

Root cause: `gui/templates/requirements/searchReqSpec.html:69` declares
`data-i18n="rssf.criteria"`, but the key existed in **0 of the 10** bundles
(`de,en,es,fr,it,ja,pt,ro,ru,zh`). `gui/templates/i18n/i18n.js:175` is
`var str = _strings[key] || key;` — a miss returns the key itself — and `apply()`
(`i18n.js:190-193`) overwrites `textContent` unconditionally, so the inline English
`Criteria form` in the markup was dead code.

**Expected post-fix** — a localized label in every locale, and never the raw key.

**Test cases executed**

| # | Step | Expected | Actual result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | key-coverage script over the 21 distinct `data-i18n` keys of `searchReqSpec.html` vs `en.json` | `MISSING in en.json: []` | PASS — was `MISSING in en.json: ['rssf.criteria']` |
| 2 | same coverage check against the other 9 bundles (JSON parser, not grep) | key present in 10/10 | PASS — `de,en,es,fr,it,ja,pt,ro,ru,zh` → all `true` (in-page `fetch`) |
| 3 | `python3 -m json.tool` on all 10 touched bundles | exit 0 for every file | PASS — `JSON OK` × 10 |
| 4 | a11y snapshot of the toolbar, locale `en` | `button " Criteria form"`, no `rssf.criteria` in the tree | PASS — `uid=5_26 button " Criteria form"` |
| 5 | repeat with `&locale=ro` | Romanian label, no raw key | PASS — `Formular de criterii`, `rawKeyVisible: false` |
| 6 | `&locale=de` | German label | PASS — `Kriterienformular`, `rawKeyVisible: false` |
| 7 | `&locale=fr` | French label | PASS — `Formulaire de critères` |
| 8 | `&locale=es` | Spanish label | PASS — `Formulario de criterios` |
| 9 | `&locale=it` | Italian label | PASS — `Modulo criteri` |
| 10 | `&locale=pt` | Portuguese label | PASS — `Formulário de critérios` |
| 11 | `&locale=ru` | Russian label | PASS — `Форма критериев` |
| 12 | `&locale=ja` | Japanese label | PASS — `検索フォーム` |
| 13 | `&locale=zh` | Chinese label | PASS — `搜索条件表单` |
| 14 | regression — diff each bundle against `HEAD` (parsed JSON) | exactly 1 key added, 0 removed, 0 modified, +1 line | PASS — 10/10 `added=['rssf.criteria'] removed=[] changed=[] lines +1` |
| 15 | regression — click the button (`openCriteriaForm()`) | still navigates to the criteria form | PASS — navigated to `…/requirements/reqSpecSearchForm.html?tproject_id=9081` |
| 16 | regression — authenticated render of the whole screen | header, project name, Type dropdown and the 2 toolbar buttons all translated | PASS — title `Footer Fixture Project - Search Requirement Specifications`, project name + Type options populated from the BFF |
| 17 | console after the pass | no new error/warning | PASS — 0 console errors on the authenticated page |
| 18 | `events` table after the pass | no new Error/Warning | PASS — 1 row only, `log_level 16` (AUDIT) `audit_login_succeeded`; 0 Error/Warning |

**Notes**

- The `ro` value is deliberately diacritic-free (`Formular de criterii`): all 48 pre-existing
  `rssf.*` keys of `ro.json` omit diacritics, and `formular`/`criterii` need none in Romanian.
  The whole `ro.json` bundle *does* use diacritics elsewhere (3329 of 6697) — the `rssf`
  namespace is the outlier, and the new key follows the namespace.
- The locale switcher offers 16 locales but only 10 bundles exist (`cs, fi, id, ko, nl, pl`
  fall back to `en`). Pre-existing behaviour, out of scope here; the 6 bundle-less locales
  now render "Criteria form" via the `en` fallback instead of a raw key, so they improve too.
- The bug was invisible to the Event Viewer and the console: nothing threw — `t()` simply
  returned its input. Only the rendered DOM and the key-coverage check expose it.

**RESUME**

```bash
mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -utestlink -ptestlink testlink < tmp/fixtures_1081.sql
# http://localhost:8082/gui/templates/requirements/searchReqSpec.html?tproject_id=9081&locale=en
```
- [PASS] Merge-base gate: `TLU_REQUIRE_SUITE="Issue #1835" bash ai/verify_test_suites.sh`
